import orders from './orders.json' with {type:'json'};

export async function listTools() {

    name: 'order_status',
    description: 'Look up the current status of an order. Optionally include its chronological history.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        order_id: { type: 'string', description: 'The order identifier to look up.' },
        include_history: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Whether to include the chronological history of the order.', default: false }
      },
      required: ['order_id'],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'order_status') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  
  // Validate arguments
  const a = args || {};
  
  // Check for extra fields
  const allowed = new Set(['order_id', 'include_history']);

  if (includeHistory) {

}
